```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

gene_id <- "Peve_00037895"
cpg_id  <- "CpG_Porites_evermani_scaffold_621_73376"
mir_id  <- "Cluster_11615"

## -----------------------------
## GENE EXPRESSION (NO NAME COLLISION)
## -----------------------------
gene <- read_csv("/Users/sr320/GitHub/ConTra/data/full-species-biomin/cleaned_peve/gene_counts_cleaned.csv") %>%
  mutate(clean_gene = str_extract(gene_id, "Peve_\\d+")) %>%   # extract clean gene name
  filter(clean_gene == !!gene_id) %>%                          # compare to argument
  select(-gene_id, -clean_gene) %>%                            # keep data only
  unlist() %>% as.numeric()

## -----------------------------
## METHYLATION
## -----------------------------
meth <- read_csv("/Users/sr320/GitHub/ConTra/data/full-species-biomin/cleaned_peve/wgbs_counts_cleaned.csv") %>%
  filter(cpg_id == !!cpg_id) %>%
  select(-cpg_id) %>%
  unlist() %>% as.numeric()

## -----------------------------
## miRNA
## -----------------------------
mir <- read_csv("/Users/sr320/GitHub/ConTra/data/full-species-biomin/cleaned_peve/mirna_counts_cleaned.csv") %>%
  filter(mirna_id == !!mir_id) %>%
  select(-mirna_id) %>%
  unlist() %>% as.numeric()

## -----------------------------
## CHECK ALIGNMENT
## -----------------------------
lengths <- sapply(list(gene, meth, mir), length)
print(lengths)
stopifnot(all(lengths == lengths[1]))

## -----------------------------
## CONTEXT SPLITTING
## -----------------------------
miRNA_state <- ifelse(mir > median(mir, na.rm = TRUE),
                      "High miRNA", "Low miRNA")

df <- tibble(
  Expression = gene,
  Methylation = meth,
  miRNA = mir,
  miRNA_state = miRNA_state
)

## -----------------------------
## PLOT
## -----------------------------
ggplot(df, aes(x = Methylation, y = Expression, color = miRNA_state)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("High miRNA" = "#D55E00",
                                "Low miRNA"  = "#0072B2")) +
  labs(
    title    = "miRNA levels modulate CpG methylation effects on gene expression",
    subtitle = paste("Gene:", gene_id, "| CpG:", cpg_id, "| miRNA:", mir_id),
    x = "CpG Methylation",
    y = "Gene Expression",
    color = "miRNA state"
  )
```
